note: Auth tokens are routed to chrome.storage.session (RAM-only) by design. In SavedPromptsService-*.js a Set On holds accessToken, refreshToken, tokenExpiry, startupReauthState, posture, pairingOrgMismatch. function Cn(t){ return On.has(t) ? "session" : "local" }. Every get/set goes through chrome.storage[Cn(t)]. refreshToken is session-scoped too, so grant_type=refresh_token against platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token cannot run after a session ends.

log: [bundle] On = Set(accessToken, refreshToken, tokenExpiry, startupReauthState, posture, pairingOrgMismatch)
[route] Cn(t) returns session for those keys, local for every other
